Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1. In case of any contradiction between numbers / values/ terms and conditions reflecting on GeM portal a nd Tender document(s) (like NIT, ITB, , SPC , GPC , MTC, BQC etc.), the numbers / values / terms and condi tions mentioned in the Tender document(s) shall prevail. 2. It is mandatory for all bidders to upload the price break-up in the prescribed format, duly filled, signed, a nd stamped, as part of their bid on the GeM portal. The priced bid shall not be disclosed anywhere in the u npriced bid and shall be quoted separately only in the price bid section on the GeM portal. Submission of p rices in the unpriced bid will be treated as a rejection criterion.

3. Technical MR of the bidding document is issued / uploaded in NIT as a Link in tender document (NIT) und er Clause No 11. 4. Technical MR attached with tender documents is password protected, Bidders will be required to execut e a separate Secrecy Declaration with EPCM, as a prior requisite for accessing technical documents includi ng the Licensor Specific Confidential Documents of the enquiry. Bidder shall download the format of Secrec y declaration enclosed with this enquiry and submit the scan copy duly filled in, signed and stamped by th e authorized signatory of the bidder within the cut-off date, time & e-mail address as mentioned in NIT. Th e password for accessing technical documents will be shared only with those bidders whose Secrecy Decla ration is found to be in compliance with the prescribed format and duly accepted by EPCM.Bidders are stric tly prohibited from sharing the password of confidential documents with any other vendor/Third party with out prior written consent from Tech nip. Any breach of this condition shall result in bid rejection and appro priate legal action against the vendor concerned. Additionally, submission of a duly signed NDA/ Secrecy D eclaration is a mandator y prerequisite for participation in this tender. Non-submission, incomplete submis sion, or failure to execute the NDA /Secrecy Declaration in the prescribed format shall lead to outright reje ction of the bid without further evaluation. 5. The bidder is required to submit an Earnest Money Deposit (EMD) of INR 1 Crore in total, re gardless of the number of line items quoted. The EMD amounts indicated against in dividual sc hedules on GeM Portal are provided only for system purposes and should not be considered fo r bidding. Any bid submitted with an EMD amount less than INR 1 Crore will be rejected. 6. Bidder to meet Technical & financial BQC Criteria as per NIT Clause no 3 and BID QUALIFICATION CRITER IA (BQC) . .
